g.text: How'd you wind up here in the first place?
I lost the taste for serving in the Britannic army.
I took offense to their methodology, let's say.
Can you give me more than that?
Is that where you learned to cook square spaghetti?
HAH! Someday, I'll live that down. Not today though, I see.
Well, MRE's are pretty vile, but that wasn't why I left.
Basically, a neutral, peace-keeping organization that's supposed to deploy military units as a last resort.
(They make great explosives though - just don't tell Amir.)
That seemed to have worked out great.
I'd like to deploy *your* military unit. ;)
Can I level with you for a second, Arthur?
Am I pushing the wrong buttons again?
I get the feeling this is a touchy subject.
Well, if you don't want to talk, I won't make you.
I'm not trying to upset you.
Everybody has their shit. Their painful shrapnel they'd rather not dig out.
You've been curious for a while about my army life. Why?
Why're you asking about my army life?
I'm just trying to get to know you. Really, I am.
Sheesh, sorry. Just trying to have a conversation.
I'm just trying to get to know you more.
And I'm doing this because I want to be a better friend.
And I'm doing this because I care about you.
Try chatting about the weather next time.
I'm trying to get to know you better.
So, if this isn't the right way to go about it, I'm sorry.
So, I'm sorry if I'm bothering you.
Well, next time maybe go for the weather.
I just want to know what made Arthur, *Arthur.*
I just want to know what made Arthur, *Arthur.*
I know. And I'm not mad. I'm just not ready to spill, yet. Another time.
Well. I suppose if you're willing to stand around put up with me...
It's not a story I like telling.
I know you're not trying to be rude. Or pry for the sake of it.
Because I haven't been able to stop thinking about you since I've shown up here.
But...fine. You've been a good sport. I'll give you an inch.
But digging out my painful shrapnel isn't exactly a pleasant conversation.
All right. Fine. What do you want to know?
What do you want to know?
I get it. I'll back off.
I didn't realize the stories I was asking for were painful.
I know, and I still owe you that rain check.
Why did you quit the Britannic army?
No. It's fine. I'm not saying you can't ask. I'm just saying I might not want to tell you the answers just yet.
I'm just not the kind of man who rushes into these kinds of things -
Relationships, or digging out painful shrapnel from my past.
So you might just have to be patient. Or stubborn.
When you enlist, you enlist to serve.
you tend to do it for a reason.
Something tells me you might have those qualities, however.
Heh. That explains why you're so bloody nosy, I suppose.
Your Prince. Your Country. Your brothers & sisters in arms.
Some people do it because they have nowhere else to go.
Look, I'm just not the kind of man who jumps into these kinds of things.
And the innocents you're meant to be protecting in the first place.
Some for glory. Some for power. Some to feed the voice in their heads that says "kill."
Relationships, or painful stories about my past.
But a funny thing happens, when people get into positions of power. The higher you go, the smaller people look.
Some are idiots who do it to be noble. To protect. To be heroes. Like me.
And if you don't want to be standing around waiting for me? I get it.
I didn't realize the stories I was asking for were painful.
The more people look less like themselves, and more like...dots.
I figured the ICR might be a better place to scratch that itch than His Majesty's Royal Army.
Sol knows that won't be the first time that's happened.
It's fine. Everybody has their shit.
Thanks. I'm sure we'll get there. Just...not today.
Like numbers on a piece of paper. Like incidentals.
But it was just more of the same.
I can't imagine why. You're so approachable and talkative.
I got real bloody sick of it.
I get the feeling there's more to it than that.
On what? The soldier stories or the whole "I have feelings for you" thing?
Today, at any rate. Not nearly drunk enough for the rest.
You don't like to give up an inch, do you?
I appreciate what you did share.
Heh. Won't say no to free beer.
